verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only PSTN dial-in and dial-out through Twilio's own Voice product. That ties telephony to Twilio rather than documenting SIP interoperability with a third-party trunk or carrier. No SIP trunking, SIP interface or bring-your-own-carrier documentation appears in the pack.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the service documents SIP interoperability with my existing trunking or telephony provider rather than locking me to one carrier
